{{Quote|Good day, ministers. Our work progresses quickly. The Force wills life to grow. Soon this valley will once more be green and fruitful.|Jedi Master Bolla Ropal|<ref name="instinct" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] served as a '''minister''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He and a [[Unidentified female Devaronian minister|fellow minister]] met with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]] to establish a [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Republic outpost]] on Devaron. Although the ministers did not want the war to come to Devaron, they allowed the base to be built. He was later present when the base came under [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|attack]] from [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] forces under the command of [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] dignitary was a minister of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he and [[Unidentified female Devaronian minister|another minister]] of Devaron met with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]], who wished to establish a [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Republic outpost]] on the planet. The ministers did not wish for the war to spread to Devaron, but after Ropal reassured them that the outpost would be used more for future production rather than waging war, they allowed the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to establish the base.<ref name="instinct" />

Nevertheless, [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], who had recently [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|stolen]] a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], led [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] forces to Devaron to capture Ropal in hopes the Jedi could access the holocron. The Devaronian minister was present when the Confederate forces [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|attacked]] Devaron shortly after the ministers' meeting with Ropal, catching the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces off-guard and taking the Jedi captive.<ref name="instinct" />

==Personality and traits==
The Devaronian minister had no wish for his planet to get involved in the Clone Wars, but when Ropal revealed that the proposed Republic base was to be used more for production rather than military matters, he and his fellow minister agreed to allow the base to be built. He had [[Color/Legends|red]] skin.<ref name="instinct" />

==Behind the scenes==
This Devaronian's first and only appearance is in a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] of [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|Season Two]] of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''The Clone Wars'' web comic series]], ''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'', in which he received a minor, non-speaking role.
